findings.description: The worktops, hob, sink drainer and shelves are covered with the tenant's items: dish rack, crockery, chopping board and knife, food cartons, a water jug, spice rack and cloths. A bin also stands on the floor. These were not there at move-in and need clearing, with the surfaces wiped down.
findings.uncertainty_reason: This may simply be belongings that will be packed before handover; check the worktops are cleared and clean on the final day.
findings.responsibility_reason: You only need to clean to the same standard as when you moved in. Landlords can't make you pay for professional cleaning unless it was professionally cleaned before you moved in.
findings.responsibility_source: Shelter – Can landlords charge for cleaning and gardening?

findings.description: Wood-effect trim along the bottom of the wall cabinet door was already worn, scuffed and peeling at move-in. It looks the same at move-out.
findings.responsibility_reason: This was already there when you moved in. Tenants can be charged for damage they cause, such as holes or stains, so recording it now protects your deposit.
findings.responsibility_source: Shelter – Deposit deductions for damage and missing items

findings.item: Worktop to wall tile joint by sink
findings.description: A dark gap where the sealant is missing between the worktop and the wall tiles was recorded at move-in. No clear change is visible at move-out.
findings.uncertainty_reason: The joint is partly hidden by bottles and a towel in the move-out video, so check it once the worktop is cleared.
findings.responsibility_reason: Landlords are always responsible for basins, sinks, baths and toilets, and their pipes and drains.

findings.description: Black mould or dirt on the rubber door seal was already present at move-in. The seal is not filmed close up at move-out.
findings.uncertainty_reason: The seal is not clearly visible in the move-out frames; film it close up to show it has not got worse.
findings.responsibility_reason: This was already there when you moved in. Tenants can be charged for damage they cause, such as holes or stains, so recording it now protects your deposit.
findings.responsibility_source: Shelter – Deposit deductions for damage and missing items

findings.description: A torn sticker and adhesive residue on the front of the washing machine were recorded at move-in. This spot is not shown in the move-out video.
findings.responsibility_reason: This was already there when you moved in. Tenants can be charged for damage they cause, such as holes or stains, so recording it now protects your deposit.
findings.responsibility_source: Shelter – Deposit deductions for damage and missing items

summary: No new damage is visible in the kitchen. The worn cabinet trim, the missing sealant by the sink and the washing machine seal and sticker issues were all recorded at move-in, so you should not be charged for them. Before handing back the keys, clear all your items off the worktops, sink area and floor and give the surfaces a wipe, and film the washing machine seal close up as evidence.
